I farm only 0.24 hectares, so one 50kg bag of fertilizer is too big and too costly for my small plot. I will use local sorghum seed saved from last year and spread the manure from my goats on the field before planting. I cannot afford herbicide or hired labor, so I will weed by hand with my children over 20 days this season. The rains will be enough for sorghum, so I will not irrigate.
